split_policy: Reference database uses O1/O2/Os. Validation relinks original sources with different module order and diagnostic padding. O0 and SHA256-only configuration are held out. An initial O3 probe yielded binaries identical to O2, so it is preserved in build artifacts and is not counted as independent validation. All are related build variants, not independent blind implementation families; negatives and failures remain in denominators.
